title: PPL Electric Utilities participating in customer assistance events throughout September

body_markdown:
**ALLENTOWN, Pa. (Sept. 4, 2026) –** PPL Electric Utilities representatives will be offering support at various in-person locations and events during the month of September to share available assistance programs with customers to help make their electric bills more manageable. Customers can review eligibility requirements, explore available options and receive help with the application process.


The PPL Electric team will be at the following locations:


- The Salvation Army Harrisburg
506 S. 29th St., Harrisburg, Pa. 17104
**Tuesday, Sept. 8** (10:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.) and **Thursday, Sept. 17** (5:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m.)
- 2026 Senior Expo with Senator David Argall and Representative Heffley
Franklin Township Volunteer Fire Company
2440 Fairyland Road, Lehighton, Pa. 18235
**Wednesday, Sept. 9** (10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.)
- Capital Blue Cross Senior Fair
2500 Elmerton Ave, Harrisburg, Pa. 17110
**Friday, Sept. 18** (10:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.)


PPL Electric will have representatives on-site to answer questions about our payment assistance programs, such as[Operation HELP](https://www.pplelectric.com/site/Ways-to-Save/Assistance-Programs/Operation-HELP) and[OnTrack](https://www.pplelectric.com/my-account/payments/need-help-paying-your-bill/ontrack-payment-plan) , and help you apply.


Customers who are looking for support should bring proof of identification, proof of income for residents in their household and their bill account numbers.


Customers who are unable to attend can learn more about PPL Electric’s payment plans and assistance programs at[pplelectric.com/BillHelp](https://pplelectric.com/sitecore/content/ppl-jss-app/home/Ways-to-Save/Assistance-Programs) .


**About PPL Electric Utilities**
PPL Electric Utilities delivers safe, reliable and affordable electricity to about 1.5 million homes and businesses in eastern and central Pennsylvania. It regularly ranks among the country’s best utility companies for reliability and customer satisfaction. PPL Electric Utilities is a major employer and an active supporter of the communities it serves. It is a part of the PPL Corporation (NYSE: PPL) family of companies. Visit[pplelectric.com](https://www.pplelectric.com/) or connect on social media via[Facebook](http://www.facebook.com/PPLElectric) ,[X](https://twitter.com/PPLElectric) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/pplelectric/) for energy efficiency tips, bill help information, guidance on shopping for an electricity supplier, storm updates and more.
